ns2:course.label: Advances in Vet Dermatology
ns2:course.description: (V C M 488) Series of lectures, seminars and discussions devoted to the intense study of pathophysiologic aspects of the integument and related systems including: structure and functions, endocrinology, immunology, microbiology, virology, parasitology, pharmacology, oncology, and miscellaneous disorders. Students enrolling for credit will also participate in 2 hours weekly critiques of current literature. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Duplicate registration is permitted up to 4 hours. Prerequisite: DVM degree or equivalent and consent of instructor.
